## Summary

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Windows compatibility considered
- [ ] Linux compatibility considered
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior/configuration changed

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, private repository names, prompts or local execution memory are included
- [ ] Hook/lifecycle changes do not introduce continuation loops or stale-session blocking
- [ ] Routing changes do not turn JEV into an authorization boundary
